tracks.title: My Truck Has Better Wi-Fi Than You
tracks.prompt: Original comedic country-rock song with believable warm male country baritone, relaxed Southern delivery, acoustic guitar, bright electric guitar, bass, live drums, light fiddle, playful harmonies, huge singalong chorus, human-sounding phrasing. No named-artist imitation.
tracks.lyric_hook: My truck has better Wi-Fi than you.

tracks.title: Build While They Sleep
tracks.prompt: Original cinematic electronic synthwave song with distinct synthetic female-to-androgynous lead, restrained intimate verses, powerful layered chorus, deep sub bass, crisp drums, dark arpeggiated synths, wide pads and glitch accents. No named-artist imitation.
tracks.lyric_hook: Build while they sleep. Turn the maybe into motion.

tracks.title: Still Building
tracks.prompt: Original hard rock song with convincing male rock tenor, controlled rasp, two electric guitars, bass, live drums and a large original chorus. Energetic but not screamed. No named-artist imitation.

tracks.title: Permission Denied (Proceeding Anyway)
tracks.prompt: Original robotic electro song with intentionally nonhuman machine vocalist, intelligible vocoder-like formants, precise rhythm, mechanical percussion, pulse bass, granular synth and bit-crushed harmonies. Emotionally curious, not threatening. No imitation of known robot or character voices.

tracks.title: No Signal After Midnight
tracks.prompt: Original late-night alternative dream-pop song with believable intimate female alto, restrained live drums, warm bass guitar, chiming guitar, analog synths and spacious harmonies. Slightly strange but human. No named-artist imitation.
tracks.lyric_hook: No signal after midnight, but something still gets through.

tracks.title: Parking Lot Astronomy
tracks.prompt: Original instrumental indie-electronic night track, warm bass guitar, soft analog synth arpeggios, dry drum machine and live percussion blend, wistful but slightly playful, spacious bridge, no vocals, no samples, no named-artist imitation.
